# Field Thermos 750 ml

€34,00

A double-walled steel bottle built for cold mornings. Coffee poured at dawn is still hot at the end of an eighteen-hour day, and water stays cold for a full day in summer.

- Capacity: 750 ml
- Weight: 410 g
- Lid doubles as a 200 ml cup
- Dishwasher safe, except the lid seal

Each bottle is pressure-tested before it leaves the workshop and comes with a five-year guarantee against leaks.
